title: 第1327章 真相真的很可怕！

content_zh:
广场上，长公主和范庸没有理会党羽的声讨，而是下意识看向了台阶正中绑在柱子上，他们一直以为是真皇帝的男人。

顺着两人的目光，广场上所有人也都齐齐看了过去。

然后，原本喧嚣的广场便渐渐安静下来了。

只见被绑在柱子上的“炎文帝”此时正盯着他们，嘴角带着笑容，只是那笑容充满嘲讽和戏谑。

最后，他缓缓张嘴，无声地说了一句话。

只有短短两个字，但广场上所有人都听懂了。

他说：傻逼！！

这两个字如同极致的嘲讽和羞辱，当场让广场上所有人都破防了。

“草，这是真的，这特妈是真的，当初在御书房的时候，他就告诉我们真相了，只是我们不相信。”

“没错，那天在御书房的时候，那家伙拼命给我们使眼色，我们却以为是陛下最后的无能狂怒。”

“该死的，我们当初还嘲笑他，原来最可笑的是我们自己。”

广场上再度喧嚣起来，范党和长公主一党众人都脸色煞白，此时此刻他们终于想起了当日御书房所发生的一切。

当日抓了魏渊，他们在御书房庆祝胜利，长公主让人将绑着的这家伙从地牢带出来的时候，这家伙就拼命挣扎，想要告诉他们什么事情。

而当时他们都当是皇帝最后的倔强，都在嘲讽他，甚至还冲着他各种辱骂。

现在看来那家伙当时是在告诉他们真相，只是他们不知道而已，难怪他当时一脸的生无可恋，遇上他们这么一群白痴，他说什么都不听，能不生无可恋吗？

范庸想到当日的情形，也痛苦地闭上了眼睛。

长公主缓缓扭头看向炎文帝，哪怕事情已经摆在眼前了，她依旧难以置信，取出怀里的小蛊，咬破手指，便将鲜血往小蛊中的蛊虫滴去。

噗的一声，鲜血滴落在蛊虫身上，蛊虫就像是被滴了滚油一般，开始疯狂扭动起来，发出了阵阵如射吐信的声音。

她死死盯着对面的炎文帝，以往母蛊疯狂的时候，子蛊也会疯狂，她手里的皇帝傀儡也会痛不欲生，躺在地上打滚哀嚎。

可现在对面的炎文帝却笑吟吟地看着他，根本就没受到半点影响，甚至还上前一步，挑衅地挺了挺胸膛。

长公主又猛地回头看向台阶上绑在柱子上的男人，却见男人也笑吟吟盯着他，满脸的怨恨和嘲讽。

他也没有半点被蛊虫反噬的样子！

“这不可能，这怎么可能？怎么可能没有效果？”

长公主猛地看向唐逸，那张倾城绝世的脸现在狰狞如厉鬼：“你做了什么？你做了什么？！”

她声音尖锐，没有了之前一切尽在掌控中的从容，彻底失态了。

范庸，范党和长公主一党的所有人，也都死死盯着唐逸，脸上有恐惧，有忌惮，有恨意……脸上情绪别提多丰富了，但都有个共同点，恨他唐逸不死。

然而面对他们那疯狂的目光，唐逸却相当淡定，道：“为什么？很简单，给真皇帝吃了解药而已。”

“刚刚我想要揍他是真的，但揍他的时候顺便给他喂了解药，准确来说不是解药，是一众麻痹蛊虫的药。”

“也就是说吃了这种药后，狗皇帝体内的蛊虫，短时间内不再受你控制。”

唐逸抬手打了个响指，指了指长公主手中的母蛊道：“当然，你现在捏爆母蛊，狗皇帝体内的子蛊也不会受到影响。”

“至于解药，给圣女一点点时间，研究出来不是问题。”

听到这话，长公主当场就疯魔了，瞪着唐逸怒吼：“不可能，这绝对不可能，子母蛊是南疆尸蛊部和监正研究了十几年的东西，根本就无药可救，无药可解。”

闻言，唐逸和炎文帝相视一眼，都笑了起来，而嬴镇和萧蕴道一群人，看着长公主的目光已经如同在看一个白痴。

“什么意思？你们这么看着本宫是什么意思？”长公主咆哮如雷。

范庸已经反应过来，脸色阴沉地盯着长公主道：“什么意思？南疆尸蛊部已经投靠了唐逸，监正也已经是唐逸的人，你说什么意思？”

长公主如遭雷击！

监正是唐逸的人，南疆尸蛊部也被唐逸给收服了，那监正联合南疆尸蛊研究出来的子母蛊，恐怕也早就告诉唐逸所有信息了。

有了这些信息，南疆灵蛊想要解毒恐怕真没那么难了。

“该死的，叛徒，叛徒！”

长公主破口大骂。

炎文帝看向长公主，脸上已经充满怜悯之色，道：“皇妹啊，你别那么激动，其实不用监正和南疆尸蛊给唐逸透露消息，朕也早就有破解之法了。”

“要是没有破解之法，你觉得萧圭是怎么将子蛊移栽到朕身上的？”

长公主当场噎住。

对啊，子母蛊一旦种下，根本就不可能解开，除非种了子蛊的人死了。

可子蛊一直在萧圭身上，怎么跑到炎文帝的身上去了？

炎文帝抬手指了指萧圭，道：“这些年你们一直拿萧圭做实验，怎么就断定萧圭不会反抗呢？在你们研究怎么用子母蛊控制他的时候，他也在怎么研究摆脱你们的控制。”

“在你们确定子母蛊无解而欣喜的时候，他也欣喜地发现子母蛊其实是可以选择血脉的……而朕和萧圭，身上都有皇族的血。”

“所以从萧圭的身上将子蛊移栽到朕的心头，子蛊并不会有太大的排斥。”

长公主闻言难以再维持镇定，她张了半天嘴，声音才从喉咙中发出。

“所以，在他回宫的那个晚上，你们就完成了互换？是吗？”

炎文帝点点头，抚摸着胸口一脸后怕道：“没错，我们就在你以为一切顺利的时候，完成的互换。说实话当时见到箱子中的萧圭的时候，朕心里只有一个念头，那就是完蛋了。”

“结果你一走，萧圭就露出了本性，和朕完成了互换。”

“如此一来，朕就可以借助假皇帝的身份，继续掌控朝局，监控四方。”

“嘿嘿，就问你们惊不惊喜，意不意外。”
content_en:
In the square, the eldest princess and Fan Yong ignored the condemnation of the party members, but subconsciously looked at the man tied to the pillar in the middle of the steps. They always thought he was the real emperor.
Following the gazes of the two people, everyone in the square also looked over.
Then, the originally noisy square gradually became quiet.
They saw "Emperor Yanwen" who was tied to the pillar staring at them with a smile on his lips, but that smile was full of ridicule and teasing.
Finally, he slowly opened his mouth and said something silently.
It was only two words, but everyone in the square understood it.
He said: Fool!!
These two words were like the ultimate mockery and humiliation, causing everyone in the square to break their guard on the spot.
"Fuck, it's true. This special mom is true. He told us the truth when we were in the study room, but we didn't believe it."
"That's right, when we were in the imperial study room that day, the guy winked at us desperately, but we thought it was His Majesty's last incompetent rage."
"Damn it, we laughed at him back then, but it turns out that the most ridiculous thing is ourselves."
The square became noisy again, and everyone in Fan's party and the eldest princess's party turned pale. At this moment, they finally remembered everything that happened in the imperial study that day.
They captured Wei Yuan that day, and they celebrated their victory in the royal study. When the eldest princess asked someone to bring the tied guy out of the dungeon, the guy struggled desperately, trying to tell them something.
At that time, they all thought it was the emperor's last stubbornness, and they all mocked him, and even insulted him in various ways.
Now it seems that the guy was telling them the truth, but they didn't know it. No wonder he looked desperate at that time. When he met a group of idiots like them, he wouldn't listen to anything he said. How could he not be desperate?
Fan Yong thought about the situation that day and closed his eyes in pain.
The eldest princess slowly turned her head to look at Emperor Yanwen. Even though the matter was already unfolding before her eyes, she still couldn't believe it. She took out the little Gu from her arms, bit her finger, and dripped the blood into the Gu worm in the little Gu.
With a pop, blood dripped onto the Gu worm. As if it had been dripped with boiling oil, the Gu worm began to twist wildly, making bursts of sounds like spitting out messages.
She stared at Emperor Yanwen opposite. In the past, when the mother Gu was crazy, the child Gu would also be crazy. The emperor's puppet in her hand would also be in pain, rolling on the ground and wailing.
But now Emperor Yan Wen across from him looked at him with a smile, not affected at all, and even took a step forward and puffed out his chest provocatively.
The eldest princess suddenly looked back at the man tied to the pillar on the steps, only to see the man staring at him with a smile, his face full of resentment and ridicule.
He doesn't look like he's been bitten by the Gu insect at all!
"This is impossible, how is this possible? How can it not be effective?"
The eldest princess suddenly looked at Tang Yi, her alluring face now as ferocious as a ghost: "What have you done? What have you done?!"
Her voice was sharp, and she lost the composure she had before having everything under control, and completely lost her composure.
Fan Yong, Fan Dang, and everyone in the eldest princess's party also stared at Tang Yi, with fear, jealousy, and hatred on their faces... There were many emotions on their faces, but they all had one thing in common, they hated Tang Yi until he died.
However, facing their crazy looks, Tang Yi was quite calm and said: "Why? It's very simple, just give the real emperor the antidote."
"It's true that I wanted to beat him just now, but when I beat him, I gave him an antidote. To be precise, it's not an antidote, but a bunch of medicine to paralyze the Gu."
"That is to say, after taking this medicine, the worms in the Dog Emperor's body will no longer be under your control in a short period of time."
Tang Yi raised his hand, snapped his fingers, pointed at the mother voodoo in the eldest princess's hand and said, "Of course, if you crush the mother voodoo now, the child voodoo in the dog emperor's body will not be affected."
"As for the antidote, give the saint some time and it won't be a problem to research it."
Hearing this, the eldest princess went crazy on the spot, glared at Tang Yi and roared: "Impossible, this is absolutely impossible. The Zimu Gu has been studied by the Corpse Gu Department and Jianzheng of Southern Xinjiang for more than ten years. There is no cure or cure."
Hearing this, Tang Yi and Emperor Yanwen looked at each other and laughed, while Ying Zhen and Xiao Yundao looked at the eldest princess as if they were an idiot.
"What do you mean? What do you mean by looking at me like this?" The eldest princess roared like thunder.
Fan Yong had already reacted and stared at the eldest princess with a gloomy expression: "What do you mean? The Corpse Gu Department of Southern Xinjiang has taken refuge with Tang Yi, and the supervisor is also Tang Yi's person. What do you mean?"
The eldest princess felt like she was struck by lightning!
Jian is one of Tang Yi's people, and the Southern Xinjiang Corpse Gu Department has also been subdued by Tang Yi. The Jian Zheng and the Southern Xinjiang Corpse Gu have jointly researched the Zimu Gu, and I am afraid he has already told Tang Yi all the information.
With this information, it might not be that difficult to detoxify the Southern Xinjiang Spirit Gu.
"Damn, traitor, traitor!"
The eldest princess cursed loudly.
Emperor Yanwen looked at the eldest princess, his face already full of pity, and said: "Imperial sister, don't be so excited. In fact, I don't need Jianzheng and Nanjiang Corpse Gu to reveal the news to Tang Yi. I already have a way to solve it."
"If there is no way to break it, how do you think Xiao Gui transplanted the sub-gu into me?"
The eldest princess choked on the spot.
Yes, once the mother-child Gu is planted, it is impossible to untie it unless the person who planted the mother-gu dies.
But the Zi Gu was always on Xiao Gui, so why did it end up on Emperor Yan Wen?
Emperor Yan Wen raised his finger and pointed at Xiao Gui, saying: "You have been experimenting on Xiao Gui for these years, how can you conclude that Xiao Gui will not resist? When you are studying how to use the mother-child Gu to control him, he is also studying how to get rid of your control."
"While you are happy that you are sure that the Mother-child Gu has no solution, he is also happy to discover that the Mother-child Gu can actually choose your bloodline... And Xiao Gui and I both have the blood of the royal family."
"So if Zi Gu is transplanted from Xiao Gui's body into my heart, Zi Gu won't be too repelled."
The eldest princess could no longer maintain her composure after hearing this. She opened her mouth for a long time before the sound came out of her throat.
"So, you completed the exchange the night he returned to the palace? Is that right?"
Emperor Yanwen nodded, stroked his chest and said with a scared look on his face: "That's right, we completed the exchange just when you thought everything was going well. To be honest, when I saw Xiao Gui in the box, I only had one thought in my mind, that it was over."
"As soon as you left, Xiao Gui showed his true nature and completed the exchange with me."
"In this way, I can use the identity of the fake emperor to continue to control the court and monitor all directions."
"Hey, I'm just asking you if you're surprised or not."
title_en: Chapter 1327 The truth is really scary!
